title: CreatorHub built-in skill configuration
description: Configuration items for the CreatorHub Xiaohongshu publishing sidecar. Effective config = defaults -> user file (<opc_home>/config/creatorhub.yaml) -> CLI flags.

data_root.description: Profiles / media / db root. Empty string resolves to <opc_home>/integrations/creatorhub at runtime.

platform.description: Target platform. Only Xiaohongshu (xhs) is supported today.

xhs_browser_mode.description: auto = use the system Brave/Chrome; cdp = launch a controlled Chrome via CDP.

browser.description: Advisory: which system browser CreatorHub drives. Brave is preferred (bravenative).

headless.description: Advisory: run the driven browser headless.

auto_launch.description: Launch the sidecar automatically when `opc-creatorhub open` runs.

open_page.description: Open the web page in the default browser after the sidecar is healthy.

auto_stop_on_exit.description: Stop the sidecar when SafeOPC exits.
